description: This file defines the 'GameScreen' widget for a Flutter-based Tic Tac Toe mobile game. It manages the user interface, including player info, game board, mode toggles, and score actions. It also handles displaying game results via snackbars.

classes.name: GameScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that renders the game interface, including the game board, player info, mode toggle, and score controls.

methods.name: _playerTopLabel
methods.description: Returns the label for the top player section based on the current game mode.

methods.name: _playerBottomLabel
methods.description: Returns the label for the bottom player section based on the current game mode.

methods.name: _maybeShowSnack
methods.description: Displays a SnackBar notification based on the game result, indicating if a player has won or if it's a draw.
